Global options such as `--base-url`, `--tenant` and `--json` go before the command — see [CLI reference](./index.mdx#global-options). Exit codes are listed in [Exit codes](./exit-codes.md).

## apiome versions {#versions}

List and fetch project versions.

```text
apiome versions [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

Subcommands: [`get`](#versions-get), [`list`](#versions-list), [`publish`](#versions-publish), [`unpublish`](#versions-unpublish).

## apiome versions get {#versions-get}

Fetch one version (GET /v1/versions/{tenant_slug}/{project_id}/{version_id}).

```text
apiome versions get [OPTIONS] VERSION_ID
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `VERSION_ID` | uuid | yes | Version record UUID. |

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--project-id` | uuid |  | yes | Parent project UUID. |

## apiome versions list {#versions-list}

List project versions (GET /v1/versions/{tenant_slug}/{project_id}).

```text
apiome versions list [OPTIONS]
```

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--project-id` | uuid |  |  | Restrict results to one project (required unless listing all projects). |

## apiome versions publish {#versions-publish}

Publish a version (POST …/{version_record_id}/publish).

```text
apiome versions publish [OPTIONS] VERSION
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `VERSION` | text | yes | Version UUID, or a slug/label when --project is supplied. |

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--project` | text |  | yes | Project UUID or slug. |
| `--visibility`, `-v` | text | `public` |  | Publish visibility: 'public' (catalog) or 'private' (tenant-protected). |

## apiome versions unpublish {#versions-unpublish}

Return a published version to draft (POST …/{version_record_id}/unpublish).

```text
apiome versions unpublish [OPTIONS] VERSION
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `VERSION` | text | yes | Version UUID, or a slug/label when --project is supplied. |

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--project` | text |  | yes | Project UUID or slug. |
